mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_template (name, type, amount, min_spend, scope, total_qty, valid_days, description, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{minSpend}, #{scope}, #{totalQty}, #{validDays}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT count(*) FROM coupon_template
AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET claimed_qty = claimed_qty + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND claimed_qty < total_qty
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (template_id, user_id, code, status, source, expire_at) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{userId}, #{code}, #{status}, #{source}, #{expireAt})
mapper.sql: c.id, c.template_id, c.user_id, c.code, c.status, c.source, c.expire_at, c.used_at, c.created_at, t.name, t.type, t.amount, t.min_spend, t.scope, t.description
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'UNUSED' AND expire_at < now()
UPDATE redeem_code SET status = 'USED', used_by = #{userId}, used_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'UNUSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redeem_code (code, template_id, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{templateId}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT count(*) FROM redeem_code r
AND r.status = #{status}
